fullTextEN: Welcome to www.lazychinese.com!
I am Xika from Taiwan.
How are you?

fullTextZH: 今天的影片是这个系列的第四个影片。
fullTextEN: Today's video is the fourth in this series.

fullTextZH: 这个系列介绍了中国文化黑暗、
fullTextEN: This series introduces the dark side of Chinese culture,
the negative side.
In previous videos,

fullTextZH: 我们聊到中国重男轻女的传统文化。
fullTextEN: we talked about the traditional culture of male preference in China.

fullTextZH: 所以以前的女人很可怜 ，
fullTextEN: So women in the past were very pitiful,
they bound their feet,
they had unpleasant names.

fullTextZH: 今天我要告诉你另一个故事：
fullTextEN: Today I want to tell you another story:

fullTextZH: 这是一个台湾女人的故事，
fullTextEN: This is a story of a Taiwanese woman,

fullTextZH: 让你看看中国传统文化对人的影响。
fullTextEN: to show you the impact of traditional Chinese culture on people.
In Taiwan in 1935,
there was a little girl named Axin.
When Axin was a baby,

fullTextZH: 她的爸爸妈妈送她到别人家里，
fullTextEN: her parents sent her to another family,
to be someone else's daughter.

fullTextZH: 阿信要叫别人爸爸妈妈。
fullTextEN: Axin had to call others mom and dad.
Now, Axin has a new home,
She grows up in the new home.

fullTextZH: 在这个新家还有一个小男孩，
fullTextEN: In this new home, there is also a little boy,
He is called Azhao.
Azhao is 4 years older than Axin,
They grow up together,
like brother and sister.

fullTextZH: 以前的小孩和我们不一样，
fullTextEN: Children in the past were different from us,

fullTextZH: 他们很小的时候就要工作。
fullTextEN: They had to work when they were very young.
What kind of work did they do?

fullTextZH: 阿照要去田里帮忙种田，
fullTextEN: Azhao had to go to the fields to help with farming,

fullTextZH: 阿信要在家里帮忙洗衣服、煮饭。
fullTextEN: Axin had to help with laundry and cooking at home.
Axin is a girl,
so she only studied for 6 years.
After graduating from elementary school,
she didn't go to school anymore,

fullTextZH: 因为她的养父，就是她的
fullTextEN: because her adoptive father, who is her

fullTextZH: 新爸爸说：“女人念书念太多不好，
fullTextEN: new father, said: "It's not good for women to study too much,
they will think too much."
One year during the New Year,
Axin is 18 years old,
Azhao is 22 years old.
Their father said: "Okay,
this year you, Axin and Azhao,
you should become adults."
Hmm,

fullTextZH: 你猜“当大人”是什么意思呢？
fullTextEN: Do you guess what "become adults" means?
Father means:

fullTextZH: 要阿信和阿照两个人一起睡觉，
fullTextEN: Axin and Azhao should sleep together,
doing what husbands and wives do!
Can you imagine?

fullTextZH: 有一天你的哥哥突然变成你的老公，
fullTextEN: One day your brother suddenly becomes your husband,

fullTextZH: 或是你的妹妹突然变成你的老婆！
fullTextEN: or your sister suddenly becomes your wife!
Everyone should
feel very strange, right?

fullTextZH: 可是阿照和阿信不能不听
fullTextEN: But Azhao and Axin cannot disobey
cannot disobey their father's words.

fullTextZH: 他们的爸爸准备了一张床，
fullTextEN: Their father prepared a bed,
placed it in a small room,

fullTextZH: 他要阿照和阿信去那里睡，
fullTextEN: he wants Azhao and Axin to sleep there,
If they don't go there to sleep,
then go sleep in the kitchen,
go sleep with the pigs!
Women like Axin,
we call them 'child brides'.

fullTextZH: 她们小时候开始住在公公婆婆家，
fullTextEN: They started living at their in-laws' house when they were young,

fullTextZH: 就是先生的爸爸妈妈家，
fullTextEN: which is the husband's parents' house,
they grew up with their husbands.
When they reached their teens,
they married their husbands.

fullTextZH: 童养媳在汉人的传统文化里有很多，
fullTextEN: Child brides were common in Han Chinese traditional culture,
for example, in Taiwan,
before 1970,
many women were child brides.

fullTextZH: 你想想，为什么以前的人这么做呢？
fullTextEN: Think about it, why did people do this in the past?
If you had a daughter,
you sold your daughter to others,
what benefits would there be?
Hmm, first,
you could get some money,

fullTextZH: 第二，你不用花钱养女儿，
fullTextEN: Second, you don't need to spend money to raise a daughter,
you don't need to give her food to eat,
no need to give her clothes to wear.

fullTextZH: 那收养女儿的人就是买别人女儿的人 ，
fullTextEN: Those who adopt daughters are people who buy others' daughters,
What are the benefits?
First, there is one more person in the family,
she can help with work;

fullTextZH: 第二，家里的儿子长大以后，
fullTextEN: Second, when the family's son grows up,

fullTextZH: 他可以和收养的女儿结婚，
fullTextEN: he can marry the adopted daughter,
he doesn't need to marry a new bride
because in Chinese culture,
marrying a bride requires a bride price,
which is money,

fullTextZH: 要给新娘的爸爸妈妈很多钱，
fullTextEN: a lot of money must be given to the bride's parents,
and many gifts must be prepared.
Look at Axin and Azhao,
they didn't get married,
no beautiful clothes,
no rings,
nothing at all!
Their dad said:
"You sleep together,"
So they slept together,
without getting married!

fullTextZH: 所以为什么有童养媳呢？
fullTextEN: So why were there child brides?
Because in the past everyone was very poor,
and had no money.
As the economic situation improved,
child brides became fewer and fewer.
The child brides of the past,
are now all grandmothers.

fullTextZH: 你觉不觉得这个故事很伤心？
fullTextEN: Do you think this story is very sad?

fullTextZH: 你能想象你的爸爸妈妈告诉你：
fullTextEN: Can you imagine your parents telling you:
"You have to marry someone"?
In your country,

fullTextZH: 你们的文化有不好的地方吗？
fullTextEN: does your culture have bad aspects?
Please leave a comment and share with me!
